verdict.rationale: Lambda's own Cloud API OpenAPI spec documents outbound webhook notifications sent to a user-supplied URL. However, the only event type evidenced is support-ticket events, not compute or instance lifecycle events. The third-party Slack/Discord notifications from the community CLI do not count as product webhooks. Missing for 10: webhook events for instances, clusters, or billing; documented subscription/registration flow and payload schema; signing, retry or delivery guarantees; independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Lambda can send webhook notifications to your URL when support ticket events occur, enabling near real-time integration with your systems.
